title: UK DWP takes online services offline after cyber incident, but benefit payments continue
summary_full: On November 27, 2026, a significant cyber incident struck the UK's Department for Work and Pensions, leading to the suspension of online services for Universal Credit and other benefits as a precautionary measure. Although regular payments remained unaffected, users faced difficulties accessing their accounts and processing applications. Cybersecurity professionals cautioned about potential scams aimed at those caught up in this disruption.
